prompt:
This is a 10-minute aerial video of road traffic recorded at 5 frames per second.

Identify every car that makes a right turn during the video.

Return ONLY a JSON array and nothing else. Each element must be:
{"box_2d": [ymin, xmin, ymax, xmax], "start": "MM:SS", "end": "MM:SS"}

- box_2d locates that car at the moment its turn begins, in normalised 0-1000 coordinates.
- start and end bound the turn itself, not the car's whole time on screen.
- If no car turns right, return [].

ground_truth.query:
REGIONS (approach = [230, 280, 340, 540], exit_right = [800, 40, 960, 130])
SELECT (v: class=car)
WHERE DURATION(v.center INSIDE approach, 3) THEN DURATION(v.center INSIDE exit_right, 3)

trqs_note: 5 warm runs of queries/UAV-rightturn.trql over the whole 19.6 min video (78 turns, 23 MB peak); one query answers every window.
